_source: Blueprint Part J: Elias's note per card when first pinned, after its relationship/deduction, and in the finale.

cards.title: Who rang the bell?
cards.first: Who rang the bell? The rope was untouched.
cards.final: The bell was a broadcast, not a warning.

cards.title: The stopped clocks
cards.final: The timeline was frozen, not the night.

cards.title: The fourth figure
cards.first: A damaged lantern is next to a missing apprentice name.
cards.after: Reveals the recurring figure as Elias.
cards.final: The fourth figure was the investigator himself.

cards.title: The dry river
cards.first: The river vanished from the surface.
cards.final: The water was diverted into the lantern channels.

cards.title: The 2:31 watch
cards.final: The village clock cannot be trusted.

cards.title: The carried child
cards.first: A silver hairclip was caught on the figure's coat.
cards.after: Reveals Nia as the carried child.
cards.final: Elias was transporting his sister to the machine.

cards.title: The Echo Lantern
cards.first: The Echo Lantern stores and transfers memory.
cards.final: The machine could bind many minds at once.

cards.title: The altered records
cards.final: He erased the evidence after the failure.

cards.title: The master console
cards.first: The master console contains an activation sequence.

cards.title: THE FIGURE
cards.first: Same outline appears near every major clue.

cards.title: NIA VANE
cards.first: Clinic card found in Mira and Arun memories.
cards.after: Matches child carried in the figure scene.
cards.final: Elias's motive for the forbidden experiment.

cards.title: THE CASE REQUEST
cards.first: Anonymous request used as the reason for the investigation.
cards.final: He created the investigation that brought him back.

_titleNote: Card titles for sis_1..mom_3 are short labels added by Nav's Claude (not in the blueprint); THE FIGURE / NIA VANE / THE CASE REQUEST are from Part J.
